ServiceTradeSessionToken.title: ServiceTrade Session Token
ServiceTradeSessionToken.x-credential-instructions: Paste an existing API session's authToken (the PHPSESSID cookie value) from ServiceTrade. Send only the value, without PHPSESSID= or a Cookie header. The API documents this legacy session method alongside OAuth client credentials. Sessions expire: replace the token when ServiceTrade rejects it. NoClick does not sign in or renew this session. The session's user permissions govern reads and writes.
